features.title: Exhibitor event location improvements
features.benefit: Place exhibitor events at any floor plan location and translate predefined locations.
features.what: An optional setting lets exhibitor events use any live floor plan location, not only the exhibitor's stand. Predefined other locations are stored per language, and exhibitor events show even when no team member is assigned.

features.title: Unified global search
features.benefit: Search everything from one field with live suggestions and a single results page that groups people, sessions and content.
features.what: The search field suggests queries as you type and opens one results page with top results, quick links, Show all views, saved queries and a way back from any detail page. Organisers control which blocks appear, their labels and order.
features.detail: The search field suggests queries as you type and opens a unified results page with top results, quick links, 'Show all' views, saved queries and a way back to results from any detail page. Organisers control which blocks appear, their labels and order, and search terms in links filter news, participants and sessions.
